source_title: Boruto Officially Kills Seventh Hokage Naruto Uzumaki's Dream
source_excerpt:
On November 10, 2014, Naruto by Masashi Kishimoto reached its end, and we finally got to see the protagonist, Naruto Uzumaki, rise to the position of the Seventh Hokage. This was a monumental chapter release for the franchise, as the boy whose journey we all had followed for years upon years finally got to fulfill his deepest desire and earn recognition from everyone in the entire world.
Fast-forwarding to the Boruto series, Naruto's Hokage dream is now officially being killed. Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 38, which was officially released on October 20, 2026, as part of the 10th volume of the series, has confirmed Konoha's next Hokage to be Konohamaru Sarutobi, ousting Naruto from the position that he held for decades.
Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Is Making Konohamaru Sarutobi The 8th Hokage
The Boruto series has dealt a lot of damage to the reputation of the Seventh Hokage, Naruto Uzumaki. For starters, Boruto Chapter 55, released officially on February 19, 2021, in V-Jump Issue 4, saw to it that Naruto Uzumaki lost the vast majority of his Nine-Tails as well as Six Paths powers, leaving him in a nerfed state.
"Normally, when a Jinchuriki's Biju is extracted, they die. But that doesn't apply to you. The Biju chakra simply vanishes. It might look to others like you're dead, but you're just in a temporary state of shock. Don't worry, you'll wake up soon. The price to pay for Baryon Mode is my life, not yours. I've got to go, but be real careful. You aren't gonna have superhuman strength anymore. So if you overdo it, you'll end up joining me soon. But until that day comes, you be well, Naruto." — Kurama dies, Boruto Chapter #55
Shortly after, in Boruto Chapter 77, Kawaki, Naruto's adopted son, decided to seal him away on January 19, 2023, cutting him out of the plot entirely. If that wasn't bad enough, then Boruto: Two Blue Vortex has now decided to kill Naruto's biggest dream forever. As confirmed in Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 38, titled "Follow Your Heart," which is part of the post-Mamushi arc and was released on October 20, 2026, Konoha is officially electing a brand new Hokage in the form of Konohamaru Sarutobi . This means Naruto Uzumaki's position as the Seventh Hokage is now permanently erased.
Kashin Koji: Kobu has plans to oust you from the Hokage seat and install Konohamaru Sarutobi as your Successor.
Shikamaru: He means to make Konohamaru the Hokage?
Kashin Koji: For the sake of appearances only. In reality, Kobu means to take control of Konoha by himself. Konohamaru will only be the figurehead to gain support of the Konoha public. A puppet regime.
— Koji reveals Konohamaru's 8th Hokage plan, Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter #38
Up until now, the position of Hokage was held by Shikamaru Nara. However, he was only the temporary Hokage of Konoha. In other words, had Naruto made a comeback, he would then get his Hokage position back, while Shikamaru would then continue to serve as his right-hand man. Now, however, Shikamaru is being taken into custody for collaborating with the traitor Boruto Uzumaki . In the meantime, Kobo, one of the underlings of the Daimyo of the Land of Fire, is going to make Konohamaru the Eighth Hokage of the village, ending Naruto's dream once and for all.
Naruto's Biggest Hokage Dream Is Officially Over In Boruto
Ever since the beginning of the Naruto series, the young Uzumaki has always wanted to become the Hokage of the village. Naruto's entire journey was to earn the acknowledgement of everyone and rise both in terms of strength and stature in order to claim the Hokage position. When Naruto Uzumaki achieved this in the last chapter of the Naruto series, it felt like the conclusion of a tremendous journey. Unfortunately, the Naruto series did not give us much of the young Uzumaki reigning as the Seventh Hokage. That is why many fans of the series were delighted with Boruto, as it showed us how Naruto Uzumaki governed the village as the Seventh Hokage. Unfortunately, things have gone from bad to worse for Naruto Uzumaki in this new series, and his dream, which has been rather short-lived, has now ended forever .
"If they can take you out and get rid of Boruto, even better. Then, with these so-called threats gone, they'll gain ample justification for dismantling the Shinobi Villages, citing them as needless military Strength." — Kashin Koji explains the destruction of ninja villages, Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter #38
In the timeline of the Boruto series, 3 years have passed since the sealing of the Seventh Hokage. The rest of the world knows Naruto Uzumaki to have already died, which is why Konoha moved towards electing a new Hokage. However, Shikamaru has figured out on many occasions that Naruto Uzumaki is alive, which is one of the reasons why he never took the position of Hokage permanently.
Unfortunately for Shikamaru, he has now been confirmed to be guilty of collaboration with the traitor Boruto, which will lead to his arrest. This confirmation came in Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 38 through Kobu's collaboration with Nishi. Now that Shikamaru is out of the way, it is time for Konohamaru to be established as the Eighth Hokage of the village. This was confirmed by Kobu in the latest chapter, but also seen by Kashin Koji in one of his Prescience visions in Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 37 on September 19, 2026. In other words, Naruto's fate is already sealed, and his dream is now crushed forever. Sad as that may be for many fans.
"Abetting a traitor is a serious crime. It'd be no different for the accomplices, but for now, as the leader, the Hokage must be held accountable right away. I've already submitted a report to Lord Daimyo, so it is only a matter of time before we receive his approval to relieve Shikamaru Nara as the Hokage." — Kobu moves to replace Shikamaru as Hokage, Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter #36

Naruto Uzumaki's Role In Boruto After Return
It is quite clear to see that Naruto Uzumaki's role as the Seventh Hokage of the village is officially ending in the Boruto series, but he still has a role to play at some point later down the line in the story. Naruto Uzumaki's return is close now, and the proof of that is Sasuke's return being facilitated in the post-Mamushi arc . As Sasuke returns, Ikimoto and Kishimoto can work towards the return of Naruto Uzumaki, which all of us are eagerly waiting for.
Once Naruto does return, however, he will no longer be the Seventh Hokage of the village. This may be disappointing to many fans, but in many ways it could prove to be a blessing in disguise as well. The Hokage office has kept Naruto away from the main action for a very long period of time. This has also meant that Naruto grows weaker due to not being involved in action as often.
Losing the Hokage position to Konohamaru could allow Naruto Uzumaki to take on important missions once again. If Naruto heads out on more missions, he can stay more active as a ninja and, above all, gain new potential powers. While it truly does sting fans that Naruto will no longer be the Hokage of the village, his role could still be enhanced in the Boruto series in ways that we could all go on to enjoy.
Mikio Ikemoto has been fixing the vast majority of the flaws of the Boruto series in the Two Blue Vortex manga, and we can only hope that Naruto's characterization is improved drastically upon his return . For now, the vast majority of the focus remains on the return of Sasuke Uchiha. As things stand, Boruto: Two Blue Vortex Chapter 39 is set to be released on November 20, 2026, and it will continue to pave the way for Hidari's defeat.
All chapters of the Boruto: Two Blue Vortex manga by Mikio Ikemoto, supervised by Masashi Kishimoto, are available to read via Manga Plus and Viz Media .
